name: Ertegas
description: Ertegas was an agriworld located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was run by a populace of agri-droids overseen by a small number of Humans, and the future Bespin Wing Guard member Allen Neff hailed from the world.
lead_paragraphs: Ertegas was an agriworld located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was run by a populace of agri-droids overseen by a small number of Humans, and the future Bespin Wing Guard member Allen Neff hailed from the world.
